Name: Hungry Pathing
Description: Beta. Working beavers plan food and water around their shift instead of waiting for the hunger penalty: they top off before a shift they cannot finish, leave far jobs early enough to reach a storage before the penalty, and while working they eat at the closest stocked storage instead of walking across the map for a fancier meal. Everything is decided from simulation state only, nothing is written to saves, and in multiplayer every player must run the same version with the same settings file.
